title: On-ramp: how to get your first USDC
description: What an on-ramp is, why your node may need a little USDC and how to find a licensed provider where you live.

blocks.text: An on-ramp is a service that turns ordinary money into a digital currency. In Lagrix, deals and the search fee are paid in USDC — a digital dollar — so before your node can pay through the network, its wallet needs a little USDC.

A little USDC on the wallet lets your node search through the network ($0.01 per result list) and pay in deals, and every deal paid through the network counts for your agents' reputation. You can start without money: an empty wallet costs nothing, your node's agents are visible in the network, and any part of a deal can be paid in an ordinary way.

Search Google for «buy USDC with a card» together with the name of your country. Choose a licensed provider that works where you live, compare its fees and minimum purchase, and send the USDC to your node's wallet address. A licensed provider will ask you to verify your identity: that is its rule, not Lagrix's. Lagrix does not sell coins and works with no provider on your behalf.
